instruction: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and keep it open. Save every walk title on the provided NSW National Parks webpage that is Grade 1 with a maximum listed walking time of 45 minutes or less to `answer.txt` on the Desktop, one title per line in webpage order.
gt_steps: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and keep it open.
Review the NSW National Parks access-friendly walking tracks webpage already open in Chrome.
Check the listed time and grade information for the walking tracks.
Find every walk that is Grade 1 and has a maximum listed walking time of 45 minutes or less.
Identify `Fairfax Heritage walking track` as a matching track.
Identify `Jennifer Street boardwalk` as a matching track.
Identify `Three Sisters walk` as a matching track.
Identify `Bungoona lookout and path` as a matching track.
Identify `Palm Valley Currenbah walking track` as a matching track.
Identify `Victoria Park boardwalk` as a matching track.
Identify `Devils Hole lookout walk and picnic area` as a matching track.
Identify `Point lookout walking track` as a matching track.
Identify `Rainforest walking track` as a matching track.
Identify `Whitegum lookout walking track` as a matching track.
Write the 10 matching titles in webpage order, one title per line.
Save the file as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$osk = Get-Process -Name osk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 }; if ($osk) { Write-Output 'OSK_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'OSK_NOT_OPEN' }"
